contributing_factors.name: otel-demo/Deployment/frontend
contributing_factors.reasoning: The frontend Deployment's 100m CPU ceiling is the upstream fault: CPU throttling is firing before the frontend-proxy error-rate alert, and throttled frontend work is consistent with the upstream connection terminations and 503s. The frontend-proxy errors are downstream symptoms, not a second independent cause.
contributing_factors.evidence: alerts/alerts_at_2025-12-15T17-40-53.360631.json reports CPUThrottlingHigh firing since 17:25:45 for pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-zjtpt at 26.79%; k8s_objects_raw.tsv at 17:29:40 shows Deployment otel-demo/frontend with one ready replica and a 100m CPU limit (50m request). The later RequestErrorRate alert for frontend-proxy starts at 17:39:29. otel_logs_raw.tsv records 503 UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination} responses routed to upstream cluster frontend (for example at 17:27:00 and 17:34:45), and otel_traces_raw.tsv at 17:34:45 shows the load-generator GET and frontend-proxy ingress ending in 503 while its frontend egress reports connection termination.
